chapterInfo.content:
62
Sion daakye animuonyam
1Sion nti meremmua m’ano,
na Yerusalem nti merenyɛ komm,
de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ ne tenenee bepue sɛdeɛ adekyeeɛ haran,
na ne nkwagyeɛ adɛre sɛ tɛnee.
2 # Yes 65.15; Adi 2.17 Na amanaman bɛhunu wo bembuo,
na ahemfo nyinaa ahunu w’animuonyam,
na wɔato wo din foforɔ
a AWURADE ano bɛkyerɛ no.
3Na wobɛyɛ ahokeka abotire, AWURADE nsa mu
ne ɔhene abotitene, wo Nyankopɔn nsam.
4 # Yes 60.15; Hos 2.19 Wɔremfrɛ wo sɛ: Deɛ wɔagya no, bio,
na w’asase nso, wɔrense no sɛ: Afo, bio,
na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo sɛ: Hefsiba,#62.4 Hebri no asekyerɛ ne: M’anisɔ wɔ ne mu.
ne w’asase nso sɛ: Beula,#62.4 Hebri no asekyerɛ ne: Ɔbaa warefoɔ.
ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ani sɔ wo,
na w’asase nso, wɔbɛware no.
5 # Sef 3.17 Na sɛdeɛ aberanteɛ ware ababaa no,
sɛ wo mma bɛware woɔ ne no.
Sɛdeɛ ayeforɔkunu ho sɛpɛ no ayeforɔ ho no,
saa ara nso na wo Nyankopɔn ho bɛsɛpɛ no wo ho.
6 # Yes 52.8 W’afasuo so, O Yerusalem,
na mede awɛmfoɔ maduadua.
Adekyeeɛ nyinaa ne anadwo nyinaa daa,
wɔremmua wɔn ano;
mo a mokae AWURADE no,
monnyɛ komm koraa.
7Na mommma no nnye n’ahome
kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛtoto Yerusalem
ama no asi hɔ ayɛ ayeyie wɔ asase soɔ.
8 # Yes 65.21-22 AWURADE aka ne nifa ne
ne tumi basa ho ntam sɛ:
Meremfa w’ayuo memma
w’atamfo nni bio,
na ananafoɔ mma rennom wo nsa
a wobrɛɛ ho no.
9Na wɔn a wɔboa ano na wɔbɛdi
ayi AWURADE ayɛ,
na wɔn a wɔde ba efie no bɛnom,
wɔ me kronkronbea abannwa so.
10 # Yes 57.14 Monsene, monsene mfa kuro apono no mu,
mommɔ ɔman no kwan;
montu ngu so, montu ngu so nyɛ no tempɔn,
montase so aboɔ;
monsi aman no so frankaa.
11 # Sak 9.9; Yes 40.10; Adi 22.12 Hwɛ, AWURADE ama wɔate
akɔduru asase awieeɛ nohoa sɛ:
Monka nkyerɛ Sion babaa sɛ:
Hwɛ, wo nkwagyeɛ reba;
hwɛ, n’akatua ka ne ho,
na n’ananmuhyɛ di n’anim.
12 # Yes 35.10 Na wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn sɛ ɔman kronkron,
wɔn a AWURADE agye wɔn,
na wo nso, wɔbɛfrɛ wo Deɛ wɔahwehwɛ n’akyiri kwan,
kuro a wɔannyaa no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
